name_vi: Ba lô mây một quai chéo
description_en: A narrow teardrop woven pack with diagonal textile zipper and a single adjustable padded sling. Canonical front: a teardrop woven face and diagonal zipper line. Side view: the curved shallow gusset and upper strap ring. Rear view: one wide diagonal shoulder strap on a padded backing. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the same teardrop woven sling backpack; preserve its EXACT body, single strap, diagonal zipper, cane bindings, natural tan color and all materials. Change ONLY camera viewpoint. CAMERA CORRECTION: turn the photographed bag slightly until its large teardrop woven FRONT PANEL directly faces the lens in exact azimuth0 front elevation, camera level with the center. The whole front panel is face-on; no broad right or left side gusset or back lining surface may be visible. The single shoulder strap remains behind the body as designed, not moved onto the front. Do not redesign or close the zipper. Whole object centered with generous margins, same warm-white backdrop and soft shadow. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, logos, labels, letters, numbers, symbols, watermark, props or collage.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
